name: sse
description: Server-Sent Events with memory or Redis transport for multi-replica delivery.
env: # Server-Sent Events transport: memory for one API replica, redis for multiple replicas
instructions: Publish a message (in another terminal):  curl -XPOST localhost:5002/events -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"message":"hello"}'
Set SSE_TRANSPORT=redis for delivery across API replicas; Redis uses the shared REDIS_URL or individual Redis settings.
Inject EventsService and call publishAsync for confirmed delivery, publish for best-effort delivery, or publishLocal for events already fanned out to every replica.
